classification.difficultyReason: Identify the common divisor from the known corresponding terms and divide the other term by it, using the paired arrows and initial supplied divisors.

answer.worked:
Divide both parts by $2$.
$$\begin{aligned}6\div2&=3\\12\div2&=6\end{aligned}$$
So $6:12=3:6$. Write $\div2$ in both operation blanks.

Divide both parts by $3$.
$$\begin{aligned}6\div3&=2\\12\div3&=4\end{aligned}$$
So $6:12=2:4$. Write $\div3$ in both operation blanks.

Divide both parts by $6$.
$$\begin{aligned}6\div6&=1\\12\div6&=2\end{aligned}$$
So $6:12=1:2$. Write $\div6$ in both operation blanks.

Divide both parts by $3$.
$$\begin{aligned}9\div3&=3\\12\div3&=4\end{aligned}$$
So $9:12=3:4$. Write $\div3$ in both operation blanks.
